reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and I'm not putting a few hundred dollars on a fixture from a store I can't vouch for when my electrician is back in three weeks. 10 to 12 business days is cutting it close, and I'd keep it saved on Pinterest rather than buy.
objection: If it arrives damaged or just looks different in my kitchen, I pay to ship a big boxed fixture back. That could be $50 to $100 or more, and I don't know this company well enough to trust it'll make things right.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, or a store that already has real customer photos and reviews from people with kitchens like mine, plus a firm delivery date that lands well before the electrician.
